upright.meaning: For anything that catches your attention, check the source or ask questions. Thinking about how you can actually use what you learn can help.

themes.blind: Are you checking the information that caught your attention?
themes.caution: Do not spread what you learned right away — look at the source.
themes.diff: Which option makes looking into things or asking people easier?
themes.letgo: It is fine to ask questions about what you do not know.
themes.want: What would you like to newly learn about?

sw12.background: A knight raises a sword and charges on horseback. The trees around bend in the wind. It shows the speed of turning a clear idea into action, and a warning against rushing too much.
sw12.name: Knight of Swords

reversed.meaning: Are you rushing to a conclusion and cutting people off mid-sentence? Check the rest of the story and everyone's readiness before you advance.

themes.blind: In your rush to conclude, is there a story you are skipping?
themes.caution: Value the necessary checks over speed.
themes.diff: Which option lets you advance together with everyone's readiness?
themes.letgo: It is fine to revise an answer you once gave.
themes.want: After finishing in a hurry, what do you want to treasure?

sw12.story: A card about acting quickly once your thinking is decided.
sw12.symbol: Air / Swords (thought, judgment) / Court card: Knight (swift attack, logic)

upright.meaning: Once you know what to do, make the first action clear. Even when you hurry, not skipping the necessary checks or the other person's reply matters.

themes.blind: Is the action you can take right now clear?
themes.caution: Even in a hurry, listen to the other person to the end.
themes.diff: Which option lets you check the purpose and move right away?
themes.letgo: Rather than hesitating forever, testing small is fine.
themes.want: What do you want to move forward quickly?

sw13.background: The queen holds her sword upright and extends her other hand forward. Clouds and a bird fill the sky. She can also be seen as listening while holding her own view.
sw13.name: Queen of Swords

reversed.meaning: Even when you are saying the right thing, might your wording be hurting the other person? Be conscious of looking at both your own view and the other person's circumstances.

themes.blind: Are you jumping to conclusions before knowing the other person?
themes.caution: Before your words turn strict, take a little time.
themes.diff: Which option lets you adjust your wording and distance?
themes.letgo: You do not have to push everyone away to avoid being hurt.
themes.want: What do you truly want the other person to understand?

sw13.story: A card about using experience to think clearly and speak plainly.
sw13.symbol: Air / Swords (thought, judgment) / Court card: Queen (clarity, independence)

upright.meaning: While treasuring your feelings, check the facts too. It is fine to say plainly what you dislike, and to decide the distance you need.

themes.blind: Can you think about feelings and facts separately?
themes.caution: Separate speaking plainly from hurting someone.
themes.diff: Which option lets you see the facts while also sharing your view?
themes.letgo: It is fine to decline plainly what you dislike.
themes.want: How far can you be involved and still feel safe?

sw14.background: The king sits facing forward, his sword upright. The sky spreads behind him — applying the same standard to everyone, without being swept by feeling alone.
sw14.name: King of Swords
sw14.story: A card about judging fairly using facts and rules.
sw14.symbol: Air / Swords (thought, judgment) / Court card: King (reason, fairness)

upright.meaning: Think first about the standard you will decide by. Explaining your reason and hearing the other person too makes a convincing answer easier to find.

themes.blind: Have you aligned the standards for your judgment?
themes.caution: Do not change the rules depending on the person.
themes.diff: Which option lets you choose while showing reasons and standards?
themes.letgo: You do not have to decide by likes and dislikes alone.
themes.want: What kind of reason could both you and the other person listen to?

reversed.meaning: Just because you are right, are you forcing the other person to obey? Review whether the rule is protecting people, and whether your wording is reasonable.

themes.blind: Are you suppressing the other person in the name of being right?
themes.caution: Even when using a rule, listen to the other person’s circumstances.
themes.want: Do you want to win, or do you want to be fair?
themes.letgo: You do not have to decide everything by your own judgment.
themes.diff: Which option lets you listen to different opinions and review?

pe01.background: A hand from a cloud holds a large coin. Below are a flower-filled garden and a path. The coin stands not only for money, but for tangible support like time and tools.
pe01.name: Ace of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Even for a promising offer, check the money and time it requires. Thinking about whether you can continue after starting matters too.

themes.blind: Have you checked the conditions of that promising offer?
themes.caution: Do not promise beyond the money and time you can use.
themes.diff: Which option can you continue with reasonable preparation?
themes.letgo: Missing one chance does not mean everything is over.
themes.want: What do you actually want to start?

pe01.story: A card about a small opportunity that helps your life or learning.

upright.meaning: Check whether there is an offer you could start, or a tool you can use. Thinking through the time and cost required makes it easier to turn into a real step.

themes.blind: Is there a tool you can use, or a new opportunity?
themes.caution: Before starting, check the cost and time required.
themes.diff: Which option can you prepare and start, as you are now?
themes.letgo: You do not have to wait for a big opportunity to arrive.
themes.want: What would you like to shape, little by little?

pe02.background: A person moves two coins connected in a loop. Behind them, the sea has large waves — adjusting how you use time and energy as situations change.
pe02.name: Two of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Are you tired from trying to do everything at once? Choose what is most necessary now, and decide what to move later.

themes.blind: Is there something suffering because you keep postponing it?
themes.caution: Before adding new plans, reduce the plans you have.
themes.diff: Which option makes it easier to narrow down what you do?
themes.letgo: You do not have to continue everything.
themes.want: Which one do you want to treasure most right now?

pe02.story: A card about balancing several things without strain.
pe02.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 2 (balance, doing both)

upright.meaning: Line up your plans and think about how much time to give each. Even if you cannot do the same amount every day, there are ways to continue while adjusting.

themes.blind: Are you leaving room in your plans and energy?
themes.caution: Do not try to do everything on the same day.
themes.diff: Which option lets you do both while adjusting the plan?
themes.letgo: It is fine not to do the same amount every day.
themes.want: Which thing would you like to spend a little more time on?

pe03.background: Inside a building, a person working and people looking at plans are talking. People with different roles are making the same thing — cooperation, and learning a craft.
pe03.name: Three of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Has who-does-what been communicated? Before blaming the other person's ability, confirm the goal and the roles together.

themes.blind: Have roles or deadlines become vague?
themes.caution: Do not put the reason things go wrong only on other people.
themes.diff: Which option lets you talk and reset the roles?
themes.letgo: You do not have to assume things have been understood.
themes.want: What kind of help would make it easier to work on?

pe03.story: A card about using each person's strengths and making something together.
pe03.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 3 (collaboration, giving shape)

upright.meaning: Instead of doing everything alone, share your strengths with each other. Showing work in progress and asking along the way makes misalignment easier to notice.

themes.blind: Do you know the strengths of the people around you?
themes.caution: Even midway, check that you are looking at the same goal.
themes.diff: Which option lets you cooperate with people of different strengths?
themes.letgo: You do not have to complete everything alone.
themes.want: Which of your abilities would you like to use?

pe04.background: A person holds coins firmly at their chest and feet. A town lies behind them. While protecting what matters, they can also look unable to move for fear of losing it.
pe04.name: Four of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Check whether you are protecting too much, or using too much. You can look for a middle way — neither holding everything nor using it all up.

themes.blind: Have you checked whether you protect too much, or use too much?
themes.caution: While anxious, do not spend a large amount all at once.
themes.diff: Which option makes it easier to decide what to use and what to keep?
themes.letgo: Using a little, or entrusting a little, does not change how precious it is.
themes.want: If you could let go of something, what would you reduce a little?

pe04.story: A card about protecting the security you have, and about feelings that cannot let go.
pe04.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 4 (holding, stability)

upright.meaning: Check what you want to protect, like money or time. When the reason to protect is clear, it becomes easier to decide the range you may use.

themes.blind: What is the thing you want to protect needed for?
themes.caution: Separate treasuring something from changing nothing.
themes.diff: Which option protects the security you need, without strain?
themes.letgo: You do not have to hold everything yourself.
themes.want: How much would you need to keep to feel safe?

pe05.background: Two people walk through snow, and light glows in the window of a nearby building. Even in cold and loneliness, help may be close. Having troubles is not necessarily the person's own fault.
pe05.name: Five of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Check the help you can use and the people you can talk to. Even if some room returns, do not suddenly increase the strain — it is fine to keep the support you need.

themes.blind: Has anything eased a little, or is there help you can use?
themes.caution: Even if room returns, do not suddenly increase your burden.
themes.diff: Which option lets you rebuild while continuing to talk to someone?
themes.letgo: Just because you could not rely on others before, you do not have to give up now.
themes.want: What support would you like to keep from here on?

pe05.story: A card about anxiety over what is lacking, and thinking about help you can rely on.
pe05.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 5 (hardship, isolation)

upright.meaning: If you have no room in money, energy, or heart, you do not have to carry it alone. Write down what is troubling you, and look for a person or place you can talk to.

themes.blind: Have you been able to look for a person or place to talk to?
themes.caution: Do not keep enduring a hard thing alone.
themes.diff: Which option makes the support you need easier to receive?
themes.letgo: You do not have to feel ashamed of receiving help.
themes.want: What do you most want help with right now?

pe06.background: A person holding scales hands coins to someone nearby. Both the giving side and the receiving side are drawn — a picture for asking whether you are helping each other without strain.
pe06.name: Six of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Has kindness come with conditions, or become hard to decline? Talk together about the range of what you ask and what you accept.

themes.blind: Have requests become one-sided?
themes.caution: Do not be kind in order to demand something in return.
themes.diff: Which option lets you talk plainly about conditions and burdens?
themes.letgo: Just because you received something, you do not have to answer everything.
themes.want: If you could decline, what would you treasure?

pe06.story: A card about helping people, and about being helped.
pe06.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 6 (sharing, balance)

upright.meaning: Help within the range you can, and accept help when you need it. Checking that the burden is not leaning to one side only matters too.

themes.blind: Are you declining help you are allowed to accept?
themes.caution: Even when being kind, keep within what you can do.
themes.diff: Which option lets you give and receive without strain?
themes.letgo: You do not always have to be the one who helps.
themes.want: What kind of mutual help would feel comfortable?

pe07.background: A person leaning on a work tool looks at a plant bearing coins. Rather than harvesting right away, they are checking how it grows — waiting, and reviewing.
pe07.name: Seven of Pentacles
pe07.story: A card about looking at what you have continued and thinking about the next approach.
pe07.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 7 (waiting, discerning)

upright.meaning: Look at what has improved compared to before, and what has not changed. It is a hint for thinking about whether to simply wait, or change the method.

themes.blind: Compared to when you started, what has changed?
themes.caution: Check how long results take to appear, too.
themes.diff: Which option lets you watch the growth and change the method?
themes.letgo: It is fine to stop once and check.
themes.want: Continuing, what would you like to grow?

reversed.meaning: Are you about to quit in a hurry, only from anxiety that no results are appearing? Look at the time you have used and the changes so far, and think about the conditions for continuing.

themes.blind: Rushing for results, are you overlooking changes along the way?
themes.caution: Do not decide whether to continue based only on the time spent so far.
themes.want: Do you want to keep going with the same approach from here?
themes.letgo: You do not have to call slow results meaningless.
themes.diff: Which option lets you set concrete conditions for continuing?

pe08.background: A craftsperson carves a pattern into coins, one by one. Finished coins line up around them. Though plain, it shows improving while moving your hands.
pe08.name: Eight of Pentacles

keywords: The same thing over and over
reversed.meaning: Are you just running up the count, or worrying too much about small failures? Check your purpose, and adjust the amount or method of practice.

themes.blind: Can you remember what you are continuing this for?
themes.caution: Do not keep fixing small mistakes until you can never finish.
themes.diff: Which option lets you adjust the purpose or amount of practice?
themes.letgo: You do not have to believe you cannot show anyone until you are perfect.
themes.want: What ability do you most want to gain right now?

pe08.story: A card about stacking small practice and growing what you can do.
pe08.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 8 (training, skill)

upright.meaning: Even if you cannot do everything at once, practice one thing at a time. Noticing what changed compared to before also shows you what to fix next.

themes.blind: What can you do now that you could not before?
themes.caution: Think not only about practice volume, but about rest and method too.
themes.diff: Which option lets you stack practice little by little?
themes.letgo: It is fine not to be good at it from the start.
themes.want: What would you like to become good at?

pe09.background: A woman stands in a fruitful garden, with a bird perched on her hand. A snail is at her feet — enjoying, at her own pace, what she gained over time.
pe09.name: Nine of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Are you spending too much time or money to look good? Check what is honestly comfortable in your life as it is now.

themes.blind: Are you overspending money or time to look good?
themes.caution: Separate relying on people from leaving everything to them.
themes.diff: Which option gives you room that fits you?
themes.letgo: You do not have to aim for a life others call impressive.
themes.want: What is comfortable even if no one sees it?

pe09.story: A card about acknowledging what you have built up and savoring a sense of room.
pe09.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 9 (independence, abundance)

upright.meaning: Take proper time to savor what you worked to gain. Rather than comparing with others, you can treasure what lets you spend your days calmly.

themes.blind: Do you acknowledge what you built up with your own strength?
themes.caution: Do not add more strain in order to protect your results.
themes.diff: Which option lets you enjoy results at your own pace?
themes.letgo: It is fine to savor what you worked to gain.
themes.want: What kind of time would you like to enjoy for yourself?

pe10.background: Near a gate, adults, children, an elder, and a dog are gathered. Ten coins are around them — people of different ages carrying life forward together.
pe10.name: Ten of Pentacles

keywords: A gap with people close to you
reversed.meaning: Are your hopes out of sync with the thinking of family or companions? Before continuing the old way as-is, talk about the circumstances as they are now.

themes.blind: Do the old rules match the circumstances now?
themes.caution: Even with family or companions, do not assume the same hopes.
themes.diff: Which option lets you discuss future roles and burdens?
themes.letgo: You do not have to match every expectation of the people close to you.
themes.want: What way of living do you need, as you are now?

pe10.story: A card about security that lasts, and supporting each other with the people close to you.
pe10.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Number 10 (inheritance, completion)

upright.meaning: Think not only about today, but about whether it can continue into the future. Talking with the people close to you about how to share time and roles can help too.

themes.blind: What people or arrangements support your current security?
themes.caution: Beyond your own good, think about the effect on the people close to you.
themes.diff: Which option has support that can last a long time?
themes.letgo: You do not have to choose only new things.
themes.want: What do you want to keep treasuring into the future?

pe11.background: A young person gazes at a coin held in both hands. Fields and farmland spread around them — taking an interest in one thing and learning it thoroughly.
pe11.name: Page of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Are you stopped at only looking things up and making plans? Decide on one practice you can do today, and work on it even for a short time.

themes.blind: Are your hands stopped at just looking things up?
themes.caution: Before making the plan more detailed, try a short practice.
themes.diff: Which option turns learning into action more easily?
themes.letgo: Even with a little lack of preparation, testing small is fine.
themes.want: If you tried just one thing today, what would it be?

pe11.story: A card about learning from the basics and giving shape little by little.
pe11.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Court card: Page (learning, steadiness)

upright.meaning: For something you want to newly learn, try starting from the easy parts. Even a short time of actually moving your hands becomes learning.

themes.blind: Are you checking the basic way of doing it?
themes.caution: Once you have a plan, test it small and for real.
themes.diff: Which option lets you learn from the basics without strain?
themes.letgo: You do not have to compare your learning speed with others.
themes.want: What ability would you like to build up thoroughly?

pe12.background: A knight holding a coin rides a horse that stands still. A plowed field lies ahead — valuing preparation and daily accumulation over speed.
pe12.name: Knight of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: In avoiding failure, are you stopping even necessary change? Change your usual method a little, and think about what you could test.

themes.blind: Has caution become your reason not to move?
themes.caution: Do not refuse even necessary changes entirely.
themes.diff: Which option lets you test a small change?
themes.letgo: You do not have to keep protecting the same method forever.
themes.want: Which part of your usual method would you change a little?

pe12.story: A card about not rushing, and reliably continuing what you promised.
pe12.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Court card: Knight (responsibility, patience)

upright.meaning: Even without big progress, keep doing what you can. Keeping a schedule that does not strain you leads to peace of mind for you and those around you.

themes.blind: Have you forgotten the plain things you keep continuing?
themes.caution: Do not promise an unreasonable amount — make a schedule you can keep.
themes.diff: Which option advances reliably, little by little?
themes.letgo: You do not have to blame yourself by comparing with faster people.
themes.want: At what pace could you continue for a long time?

pe13.background: Surrounded by flowers and fruit, the queen gazes at the coin on her lap. A small rabbit is at her feet — tending the things nearby and growing a place where you can spend time at ease.
pe13.name: Queen of Pentacles

reversed.meaning: Are you cutting into your own rest by striving too much for others? Think about what you can reduce today, and what you can leave to someone.

themes.blind: Are you pretending not to see your own tiredness?
themes.caution: Do not take on everything before you are even asked.
themes.diff: Which option leaves room for both you and the people around you?
themes.letgo: You do not have to decide that it must be you who does it.
themes.want: What would you like to rest from today?

pe13.story: A card about treasuring everyday life — meals, rest, and the like.
pe13.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Court card: Queen (abundance, practicality)

upright.meaning: Tidy the things close at hand — meals, rest, the places you use. Small care can grow peace of mind for you and those around you.

themes.blind: Might tending meals and rest be what matters right now?
themes.caution: Even when helping people, keep your own rest.
themes.diff: Which option lets you tend daily life without strain?
themes.letgo: Choosing nearby care over big results is fine.
themes.want: What kind of days would let you spend time at ease?

pe14.background: The king sits holding a coin, wearing clothes with a grape pattern. A castle stands behind him — a life arranged over a long time, and a way of working that earns trust.
pe14.name: King of Pentacles
pe14.story: A card about using the experience and tools you have built up for everyone's peace of mind.
pe14.symbol: Earth / Pentacles (work, money, reality) / Court card: King (wealth, trust)

upright.meaning: Think about how to put what you have learned so far to use. It is a hint to choose a way that continues without strain, and to share peace of mind with those around you.

themes.blind: Are you making use of your experience and the things you can use?
themes.caution: Even when stable, check the changes around you.
themes.diff: Which option builds trust over a long time?
themes.letgo: You do not have to produce new results all the time.
themes.want: With whom, and what peace of mind, do you want to share?

reversed.meaning: Protecting money and results, are you forgetting people’s feelings? Check ease of continuing and consideration for others, together.

themes.blind: Are you judging goodness by money and results alone?
themes.caution: In your fixation on protecting, do not forget people’s feelings.
themes.want: What would you treasure even without showing results?
themes.letgo: You do not have to think of changing your way as weakness.
themes.diff: Which option treasures both ease of continuing and consideration?
